# Ex04 Places Around Me
## Date: 

## AIM
To develop a website to display details about the places around my house.

## DESIGN STEPS

### STEP 1
Create a Django admin interface.

### STEP 2
Download your city map from Google.

### STEP 3
Using ```<map>``` tag name the map.

### STEP 4
Create clickable regions in the image using ```<area>``` tag.

### STEP 5
Write HTML programs for all the regions identified.

### STEP 6
Execute the programs and publish them.

## CODE
```
<!-- Image Map Generated by http://www.image-map.net/ -->
<img src="Screenshot 2025-09-23 105633.png" usemap="#image-map">

<map name="image-map">
    <area target="" alt="kishore.html" title="kishore.html" href="katrambakkam.html" coords="544,445,718,500" shape="rect">
    <area target="" alt="kishore.html" title="kishore.html" href="mevalurkuppam.html" coords="316,249,306,318,495,315,479,258" shape="poly">
    <area target="" alt="kishore.html" title="kishore.html" href="keevalur.html" coords="609,270,61" shape="circle">
</map>
```
